name: CA-46
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district (D+10 PVI) with incumbent Lou Correa running
Correa's large financial advantage: $2.5M cash vs. under $7K for Pan
Prediction markets price Correa at ~96% to win
No competitive polling or expert ratings signal a race
model.rationale: Correa is a well-funded incumbent in a D+10 district, while Republican David Pan has raised only about $81K and has minimal cash on hand. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy Democratic hold, so the forecast stays at Safe D.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Correa or an unexpectedly low-turnout primary-style electorate could narrow the margin, though not enough to threaten the outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Lou Correa, the Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in this Orange County district that leans Democratic by about ten points. He advanced to the general election and holds a decisive financial edge, with roughly $2.5 million on hand compared with about $6,000 for Republican David Pan, who has raised little and drawn no outside support.

No public polling or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Correa about a 96% chance of winning. With the incumbent's advantages in money, name recognition, and district lean all pointing the same direction, the seat is expected to remain comfortably in Democratic hands in November.
